scope: local kind worker fault recovery, HTTPS business requests and independent SQL reconciliation; not operational qualification

transports.http: HTTPS through one run-owned Service NodePort; generated CA and hostname validation
transports.database: PostgreSQL verify-full with shared run-owned fixture client certificate
transports.connection_model: new TLS/TCP connection per attempt; existing persistent sessions are not qualified

execution.driver: actual sova-service run-worker in two restricted Pods
execution.fault: pause actual owner task, wait for real lease expiry, confirm live-owner refusal, stop old Pod normally, recover by readback

load.recovery: explicit same-process lookup; retry same intent only after 404; every attempt retained
